description: This Java class defines a custom exception, CurrencyInUseException, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException. It is thrown when an attempt is made to delete a currency that is currently in use to prevent such operations.

classes.name: CurrencyInUseException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a currency cannot be removed because it is still in use.

methods.name: CurrencyInUseException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific currency code, indicating the currency cannot be removed as it is in use.
